EN: Ow! My ears! Can't wait to turn this alarm off and get some shut-eye!
ZH: 嗷！我的耳朵！等不及要关上这个鬼闹钟，然后好好睡一觉了！

EN: I regret boasting about how long I could go without sleeping in the vault!
ZH: 我真是后悔向你们吹牛说我不睡觉能坚持多久！

EN: Must be getting closer, my ears are starting to bleed.
ZH: 应该已经接近了，我的耳朵快聋了。

EN: You've earned them! Now it's time for us to get back on the road.
ZH: 你们赢得了它们。现在我们该上路了。

EN: Here you go. I hope there's something good inside!
ZH: 拿好，希望里面有什么好东西！

EN: We were headed for our grandma's place, but I guess we got a little lost.
ZH: 我们准备去外婆家，但我们好像有点迷路了。

EN: Even worse, the smell of this pumpkin pie we brought has attracted every monster in the Wasteland!
ZH: 更糟糕的是，我们带的南瓜派的香气好像吸引了废土上所有怪物的注意力！

EN: Please, take these Caps. It's the least we can do.
ZH: 请收下这些瓶盖吧。这是我们最起码能做的。

EN: Or maybe you'd rather have this Vault-Tec Lunchbox we found?
ZH: 或者你们更愿意要这些我们找到的午餐盒吗？

EN: Caps will do fine, thanks.
ZH: 瓶盖就行了，谢谢。

EN: The Lunchbox sounds great! Thank you.
ZH: 午餐盒听起来不错！谢谢！

EN: An old woman living near your Vault was expecting Holiday visitors, but they haven't arrived and she fears the worst!
ZH: 一位住在你们避难所附近的老妇人正期待着节日里的拜访者，但客人们还没有到，她担心他们出事了！

EN: To Grandmother's House We Go
ZH: 去外婆家

EN: Rescue the lost Wasteland Settlers.
ZH: 拯救走失的废土定居者。

EN: Help some Wasteland Settlers who got lost while traveling for the Holidays!
ZH: 帮助那些在度假旅行时走丢的废土定居者。

EN: Ooh! Good thing you found me! I better come with you to see what you need. You've got caps, right?
ZH: 哦！幸好你找到了我！我得和你一起去看看到底需要什么药。你有瓶盖吗？

EN: Oh no! What are we standing around for? Grab my things and let's go!
ZH: 哦，不！那我们还站在这里干什么？拿上我的东西，快走吧！

EN: We've got injured, in the junk town back there. We need a lot of meds.
ZH: 有人受伤了，在后面的垃圾镇。我们需要很多药。

EN: Filly was attacked by raiders! A lot of people are injured!
ZH: 菲利镇被掠夺者袭击了！很多人受伤了！

EN: Step right up, step right up, I've got the cure to what ails you.
ZH: 瞧一瞧，看一看嘞，我有能治愈所有疾病的药剂。

EN: Cough? Fever? Fingers growing out of your chin? I can heal it all.
ZH: 咳嗽？发烧？下巴上长出手指？我都能治好。

EN: Howdy there stranger! What exactly can I help you with today?!
ZH: 嘿，陌生人！今天我能帮你什么忙？

EN: The people of Filly are in dire need of medicine. There are rumours of a traveling chem-merchant wandering nearby. You should have no trouble tracking them down.
ZH: 菲利镇的居民急需药品。有传言说附近有一位旅行药物商人。你应该很容易就能找到他。

EN: Hooked On Tonics
ZH: 汤剂上瘾

EN: Find the Snake-Oil Salesman.
ZH: 找到蛇油推销员。

EN: Find the Snake-Oil Salesman.
ZH: 找到蛇油推销员。

EN: We made it! Let's grab everything we can.
ZH: 我们做到了！带走所有我们能带走的东西！

EN: That abandoned Vault stocked with supplies? That's Deathclaw territory now. How he got in there, nobody knows, but you won't get to the stash without facing him first. Time to break out the big guns!
ZH: 废弃的避难所里有许多物资？那里现在是死爪的领地了。没人知道死爪是怎么进去的，但想拿到物资储备肯定先得对付它，是时候拿出杀手锏了。

EN: Too Good to be True
ZH: 太好了以至于不是真的

EN: Claim the supply stash in the abandoned Vault.
ZH: 领取废弃避难所的物资储备。

EN: Claim a stash of supplies... if you can get past the Deathclaw that's guarding them!
ZH: 领取物资储备……如果你能过得了死爪那一关！

EN: The survivors ran off to Poseidon Energy's Offices. Too bad you won't be so lucky!
ZH: 幸存者逃往了海神能源办公室。抱歉你不够走运！

EN: Look! More stupid soldiers trying to get themselves killed!
ZH: 看，又有傻子士兵来找死了！

EN: You mean the Roughnecks? Where did they go?
ZH: 你是说那支硬汉小队吗？他们去哪儿了？

EN: A Dweller told me that Maxson's Roughnecks made their way to the Wilson Atomatoys Factory. That should be my next stop.
ZH: 一个居民告诉我“麦克森硬汉小队”去了威尔逊原子玩具厂。我下一站就去那里。

EN: Toy Soldiers
ZH: 玩具士兵

EN: Explore the Wilson Atomatoys Factory.
ZH: 探索威尔逊原子玩具厂。

EN: Look for Maxson's Roughnecks at the Wilson Atomatoys Factory.
ZH: 前往威尔逊原子玩具厂寻找“麦克森硬汉小队”。

EN: Aha! It's the journal of Overseer Patel! Hmm. What's this passage...
ZH: 啊哈！是监督者帕特尔的日志。这段是什么……

EN: “Had an interesting visitor - Paula Plumbkin. Weird name. Nice lady.
ZH: 来了一位有趣的客人 - 宝拉·普朗布金。奇怪的名字，但人还不错。

EN: She headed out to visit Vault 909, but I told her it had been overrun.
ZH: 她准备去909号避难所，但我告诉她，那里已经被占领了。

EN: She didn't care. Something about an epic Quest. Alrighty then.”
ZH: 她不在乎。她说是什么华丽的冒险。那就这样吧。

EN: Vault 333 has been ransacked, but maybe there's a clue to Paula Plumbkin's whereabouts!
ZH: 333号避难所遭到了抢劫，但那里也许有关于宝拉·普朗布金去向的线索！

EN: Truth Among the Ashes
ZH: 灰烬里的真相

EN: Search Vault 333 for clues.
ZH: 前往333号避难所寻找线索。

EN: Search Vault 333 for a clue to Paula Plumbkin's whereabouts.
ZH: 前往333号避难所寻找关于宝拉·普朗布金下落的线索。

EN: No I mean a magical voodoo army... Of course I mean Ghouls! Now go!
ZH: 不，我的意思是魔法巫毒军队……当然，我的意思是，尸鬼！现在去吧！

EN: Next time a Feral Ghoul is in my face, I'll make sure to listen to what it's saying. Now go!
ZH: 下一次狂尸鬼就在我眼前，我一定要听它在说什么。现在去！

EN: No, just the same rags every Feral Ghoul wears. Hmm, why is that? No matter, just go!
ZH: 不，就是每个狂尸鬼穿着的那种破布。嗯，为什么？不管，只要走！

EN: You think the Feral Ghouls might be infected? We'll call for medics. Now go!
ZH: 你认为狂尸鬼会传染吗？我们会请医务人员。现在去！

EN: Finally! You've arrived just in time, soldiers.
ZH: 终于！你来得很及时，士兵们。

EN: We're holding the line here, making sure none of those zombies make it out.
ZH: 我们在这里守住防线，确保那些僵尸出不来。

EN: But we need you to go down there and cut the head off this assault.
ZH: 但我们需要你到那里去斩断这次袭击。

EN: Look for a large group leading the pack.
ZH: 去找那个领头的大群。

EN: Zombies? You mean Ghouls?
ZH: 僵尸？你的意思是尸鬼？

EN: Did they call themselves Pests?
ZH: 他们称自己为“害虫”吗？

EN: Were they wearing Wasteland Gear?
ZH: 他们穿着废土装备吗？

EN: Did they say anything about Pestilence?
ZH: 他们说“瘟疫”了吗？

EN: Those frauds aren't nearly hungry enough. But we are. Let our hunger consume you!
ZH: 那些骗子根本就不是很饿。但我们不一样，让我们的饥饿吞噬你吧！

EN: The GREATEST Horseman to you. Now let our hunger consume you!
ZH: 最伟大的骑士。现在让我们的饥饿吞噬你！

EN: Fresh meat. Fresh meat. Rolls off the tongue. Thanks. Now let our hunger consume you!
ZH: 新鲜的肉。新鲜的肉。在唇齿间流转。谢谢。现在让我们的饥饿吞噬你！

EN: Don't be a wiseguy. No one likes a wiseguy. Now let our hunger consume you!
ZH: 不要做一个自作聪明的家伙。没有人喜欢自作聪明的家伙。现在让我们的饥饿吞噬你！

EN: The hunger, the hunger, it eats us alive!
ZH: 饥饿，饥饿，它活生生地吞噬着我们！

EN: We are the Hungry Horde, followers of Famine.
ZH: 我们是饥饿部落，“饥荒”的追随者。

EN: And all flesh fresh... I mean fresh flesh... will be consumed!
ZH: 和所有肉的新鲜……我的意思是新鲜的肉……将被吃掉！

EN: I'm sorry, we're just so very hungry. Makes it hard to focus.
ZH: 对不起，我们太饿了。难以集中精神。

EN: The Hungry Horde? So you aren't Pests?
ZH: 饥饿的部落？所以你们不是“害虫”？

EN: Famine? Like the Horseman of the Apocalypse?
ZH: “饥荒”？是末日骑士？

EN: You should try “meat” instead of “flesh.”
ZH: 你应该尝试“肉”而不是“人肉”。

EN: You're very hungry and you follow Famine. Think there's a connection?
ZH: 你很饿，你跟着“饥荒”。你觉得有联系吗？

EN: An underground military base is under attack and calling in all their Wasteland patrols. Could it be the Pests again? We need to stop them! But we'll need Military Fatigues to pass as one of the patrols and get into the base...
ZH: 一个地下军事基地遭到攻击，召唤他们所有的废土巡逻前去帮忙。难道又是“害虫”吗？我们需要阻止他们！但我们需要军装来通过他们的巡逻并进入基地……

EN: Undercover Operations
ZH: 卧底行动

EN: Stop the attack on the military base.
ZH: 阻止对军事基地的进攻。

EN: Talk to the soldiers.
ZH: 和士兵交谈。

EN: Talk to the attackers.
ZH: 与攻击者交谈。

EN: Infiltrate a military base to stop the Pest attack!
ZH: 潜入军事基地阻止“害虫”袭击！

EN: It's called dinner, and guess who just got added to the menu!
ZH: 这里有晚餐，猜猜谁会出现在今晚的菜单上！

EN: I guess we can always add “Dweller” to the menu!
ZH: 我想我们一直都可以把“居民”放在菜单里！

EN: This is a private dinner party!
ZH: 这是一个私人晚宴聚会！

EN: You're not invited!
ZH: 你没有被邀请！

EN: What's going on here?
ZH: 这里发生了什么？

EN: I was totally invited...
ZH: 我当然被邀请了……

EN: You can across a small cabin out in the Wasteland. Time to investigate!
ZH: 你在废土上发现了一个小屋。去调查一下吧！

EN: Uninvited Guests
ZH: 不速之客

EN: Explore the Cabin.
ZH: 探索小屋。

EN: You've discovered an old Cabin out in the Wasteland.
ZH: 你在废土上发现一幢旧的小屋。

EN: Vacate Novac
ZH: 驱逐诺瓦克

EN: No dogs here. Try our sister Vault: 899. They're classier. But first, take this as our token of thanks.
ZH: 这里没有狗。试试他们的姐妹避难所吧：899号。他们更经典。但首先，拿着这个吧，当做是我们的感谢。

EN: You got here just in time! We weren't expecting that last minute... infestation.
ZH: 你们及时赶到了这里！我们完全没有料到……这种灾害。

EN: Some people say 199 is pretty cheap when it comes to Vaults, but we love her all the same.
ZH: 有些人说199号作为避难所来说太简陋了。但我们还是一样喜欢它！

EN: It's easy when you've nowhere else to go!
ZH: 对于无家可归的人来说已经很好了！

EN: Has a dog named Bigsby stopped by here?
ZH: 有只叫做比格斯比的狗来过这里？

EN: The Raiders mentioned Bigsby may have fled to Vault 199. I should go ask around. Hopefully, the Dwellers have him.
ZH: 掠夺者有提到比格斯比可能逃到了199号避难所。我应该帮你问问。但愿它在居民那里。

EN: Vault 199
ZH: 199号避难所

EN: Find Bigsby.
ZH: 找到比格斯比。

EN: Look for Bigsby in Vault 199.
ZH: 前往199号避难所寻找比格斯比。

EN: I remember those! We survived the blast, but the radiation still got us. When you're this old, who cares about wrinkles, right?
ZH: 我记得那些！我们从大爆炸中幸存了下来，但还是没能躲过辐射的影响。当你已经这把年纪了，谁还在乎皱纹呐？

EN: Thanks for helping us! Those Raiders were the worst. How'd you ever find us?
ZH: 谢谢你们的帮助！那些掠夺者最坏了。你们是怎么找到我们的？

EN: I found an old advertisement while out and about.
ZH: 在外面的时候我发现了一则旧广告。

EN: While out exploring, one of your Dwellers found an old advertisement for Vault 789. Time to check it out!
ZH: 外出探险时，居民中的一员发现了一则给789号避难所的旧广告。去查看一下吧！

EN: Vault 789
ZH: 789号避难所

EN: Explore Vault 789.
ZH: 探索789号避难所。

EN: Time to check out Vault 789!
ZH: 是时候拜访下789号避难所了！

EN: No, I'm a ghost! Booooooo!
ZH: 不，我是一只鬼！吓死你——！

EN: Muwhahaha! Take this and run, little Dwellers!
ZH: 哇哈哈哈！拿着这个赶紧逃命吧，小可怜们！

EN: Ha! You can't hurt us! Wait... Ow!
ZH: 哈！你们不能伤害我们！等等……嗷！

EN: You're too late, Dwellers!
ZH: 避难所居民们，你们来得太迟了！

EN: This Vault is full of nothing but ghosts!
ZH: 这个避难所里只剩下鬼了！

EN: Boo! Boooooooooo!
ZH: 呜！呜呜呜呜！

EN: You're not dead, you're just wearing a sheet.
ZH: 你没死啊，你只是穿了件床单。

EN: Oh no, a ghost! Uh... We're so scared! What will we do?!
ZH: 哦不，鬼！呃……我们好怕怕呀！我们该怎么办呀？！

EN: Let's see if ghosts can die twice. Attack!
ZH: 就来看看你们这些鬼能不能死两次。给我上！

EN: Monstrously horrific! Here. A reward.
ZH: 真是毛骨悚然！这奖励，给你们。

EN: Existentially dreadful, but not enough! Die!
ZH: 非常让人心惊胆战，但还不够！去死吧！

EN: Ha! Now that's scary! For YOU!
ZH: 哈！现在开始吓人了！对你们来说！

EN: Fear is the only currency in this Vault.
ZH: 恐怖才是这个避难所里唯一的通行证。

EN: Tell us something scary, or risk certain doom!
ZH: 跟我们讲些鬼故事吧，不然就得死！

EN: Three words: Never. Ending. Deathclaws.
ZH: 三个词：永远。不停。死爪。

EN: You'll all die alone and unloved?
ZH: 你们都会孤独终老吗？

EN: Forget this. We're just going to kill you.
ZH: 算了，我们还是直接杀了你们吧。

EN: Ha ha! Here you are.
ZH: 哈哈！给你们吧。

EN: Here. One of my spare outfits.
ZH: 拿着，这是我们多余的装备。

EN: Here. Nothing about money scares us.
ZH: 拿着，钱什么的最不可怕了。

EN: Here. May you make something spooky with it.
ZH: 拿着，有了它你可以自己拍恐怖片。

EN: I am the Overseer. Behold our Vault of horrors!
ZH: 我是监督者。请亲眼见证我们的避难所有多恐怖！

EN: We trade in fear. A scare is worth more than Caps here.
ZH: 我们用恐怖来做交易。恐怖在这里比瓶盖值钱。

EN: But we understand if other Vaults trade in less fearsome goods.
ZH: 但是我们明白其他的避难所会用不那么恐怖的物品做交易。

EN: What can we send you back with?
ZH: 我们能回赠你们一些什么？

EN: Nothing scarier than overwhelming firepower.
ZH: 没有什么比压倒性的火力更恐怖了。

EN: We need some spooky clothes.
ZH: 我们需要一些吓人的衣服。

EN: You say you don't need Caps? We're happy to take all of them!
ZH: 你是说你们不需要瓶盖是么？我们很乐意拿走你们所有的瓶盖！

EN: Any frightful crafting junk in this Vault?
ZH: 这个避难所里有没有什么厉害的杂物可供打造吗？

EN: Super-secret secrets, that's what! We'll never talk!
ZH: 这可是高级机密。记住，我们从没说过话！

EN: Yes! Now take this briefcase. This meeting never took place...
ZH: 是的！现在拿着这个行李箱。记住，这次见面从未发生……

EN: Rogue agents! Code red!
ZH: 流氓特工！代号红！

EN: We've been breached!
ZH: 我们被入侵了！

EN: You can't have our secrets, Dwellers.
ZH: 避难所居民们，你们不该知道我们的秘密。

EN: Our precious, precious secrets.
ZH: 我们无比珍贵，无比重要的秘密。

EN: Secrets? What secrets?
ZH: 秘密？什么秘密？

EN: Don't worry. We'll keep your secrets. We were never even here.
ZH: 别担心，我们会保守秘密的。我们从未来过这里。

EN: We'll beat your secrets out of you!
ZH: 我们会把你们打跪下，看你们说不说！

EN: Excellent. You're our double-agents now!
ZH: 很好，你现在是我们的双面间谍了！

EN: You think we're idiots? Get them!
ZH: 你以为我们是白痴吗？给我拿下他们！

EN: Contact! Kill everyone!
ZH: 联络！杀了所有人！

EN: Spying is all we know. All we live for.
ZH: 我们只知道怎么做间谍，这是我们活着的目的。

EN: Give us intel on your Vault, or else!
ZH: 给我们你们避难所的情报，不然的话！

EN: Of course. We'll tell you everything!
ZH: 当然，我们什么都告诉你们！

EN: Here's some choice intel: it's underground.
ZH: 第一条情报就是：避难所在地下。

EN: No one spies on our Vault. Attack!
ZH: 没有人能藏在我们避难所做间谍。给我上！

EN: All I have is this, but you're welcome to it.
ZH: 我只有这个，但你们尽管拿去。

EN: This is our uniform. Take one.
ZH: 这是我们的制服，给你一套。

EN: Fine. Take all you need.
ZH: 好吧，拿走你们所有想要的东西吧。

EN: I like it. Here you are.
ZH: 我很喜欢，给你吧。

EN: Hello, fellow Dwellers.
ZH: 大家好呀，各位避难所的居民们。

EN: I'm the Overseer and Master Spy for this Vault.
ZH: 我是监督者，是这个避难所里的王牌间谍。

EN: Secrets are our trade! But we're happy to give you goods.
ZH: 我们用秘密来做交易！但我们也很乐意给你们一些物品。

EN: What can we send you back with?
ZH: 我们能回赠你们一些什么？

EN: Surely you have a secret doomsday weapon you can share?
ZH: 我想你们一定有末日秘密武器能分享给我们吧？

EN: How about some spiffy spy clothes?
ZH: 要不然来点帅气利落的间谍套装？

EN: Forget secrets. We only trade in bottlecaps.
ZH: 忘了秘密吧。我们只交换瓶盖。

EN: We have some secret crafting projects we need junk for.
ZH: 我们有一些秘密的打造活动，需要一些杂物。

EN: Such odd manners of speech! Off with you.
ZH: 如此奇怪的演讲！你还是走吧。

EN: Here is the bounty from our last quest.
ZH: 这是我们上次完成任务的奖赏。

EN: Have at thee!
ZH: 准备受死吧！

EN: Zounds! Adventurers from some distant land!
ZH: 嗬！远道而来的探险家们！

EN: Have you come to trade with our fair kingdom?
ZH: 你们来这里是为了和我们的王国通商吗？

EN: Or is your goal honorable combat?
ZH: 或者你们是来宣战的？

EN: You're all ridiculous.
ZH: 你们真可笑。

EN: Huzzah! We are here to trade with you, good knights!
ZH: 万岁！我们是来做买卖的呢，我亲爱的骑士们！

EN: Face our blades... er... guns! Attack!
ZH: 看剑……呃……看枪！攻击！

EN: We dub thee: Knights of the Realm!
ZH: 我们授予汝——“王国骑士”的称号！

EN: What nonsense! Away with thee!
ZH: 说的什么胡话！赶紧闪开！

EN: To arms!
ZH: 为荣誉而战！

EN: The Code of Chivalry rules here.
ZH: 在这里，骑士精神才是王道。

EN: Honesty, bravery, and hospitality are our laws.
ZH: 我们的法则就是忠诚，勇敢和友善。

EN: Do you swear to uphold these virtues while in our castle?
ZH: 你们能发誓在我们的城堡里活动的时候，能做到这几点吗？

EN: By our honor, we so swear!
ZH: 以上帝之名，我们发誓。

EN: News flash: you're in a Vault, not a castle!
ZH: 号外：你们在避难所里，不是城堡里！
